notes.title: Death Nomad v0.5 - New bunker quests and difficulty modes
notes.content:
After listening to your feedback, new mechanics have been added that significantly change how Death Nomad is played.

As before, the demo is available for those who want to try out these changes and support the project if they wish.

[previewyoutube=M1vA_RaHzAk;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]




What's New:


 Gameplay Modes: Easy, Normal, and Permadeath. In the first two modes, the player drops their inventory and will need to retrieve it after respawning at the last checkpoint. 
 Bunkers!! A new mission is available at the outpost that will take you into a bunker filled with threats. 
 New Boss: You can find it inside the bunkers. 
 New Zombie Type: You'll recognize these zombies by their luminescence, as they are workers from radioactive areas exposed to radiation for a long time. Be careful—they are stronger and attack from a distance with their radioactive vomit. 
 Rad Barrels: Shooting them releases radioactive substances you can use to your advantage... 
 Anti-radiation equipment now protects against radioactive substances. 
 Throwable items are equipped in the action bar. 
 You can toggle between interactable objects around the character using the control key + mouse scroll. 
 Starting points are instantly added and can be consumed without ending the game. The chest with the reward will appear at the outpost. 
 The leaderboard has been removed from the main menu. 
 Items now have greater durability. 
 Localization fixes for Russian in the main menu. (Thanks to the collaboration of Proxy_Yxkki)

Bug Fixes:


 Weapons no longer consume all ammo stacks from the inventory when reloading. 
 Guest players' sound direction is now perceived according to their camera. 
 The incompatible version warning no longer appears when joining a friend's game. 
 Construction planning can now be chained without needing to select it each time. 
 The mission panel no longer appears empty when starting the game as a guest. 
 Improved synchronization of player deaths. 
 Improved synchronization of burn effects. 
 The menu now closes automatically after death. 
 The camera no longer retains rotation speed when the menu is opened. 
 Action bar keys update correctly after assigning a new key. 
 The mission to clear areas no longer leaves zombies missing from the area. 
 Guest players crafting an item without inventory space now drop the item to the ground. 
 Improved bullet spread for shotguns.


Enjoy it!

notes.title: Death Nomad v0.4
notes.content:
Death Nomad has been updated, and after listening to your feedback, I've incorporated fun new mechanics that also enhance the previous ones. You're sure to enjoy it!

To let you experience it for yourself, I've prepared a demo where you can explore the early moments of Death Nomad and decide if you'd like to support the project.

[previewyoutube=-CNnefUf9jM;leftthumb]
[/previewyoutube]




What's New:


 Large stones can no longer be farmed by hand.
 Trash piles can now be harvested.
 New desert biome.
 Reduced zombie perception area.
 Increased number of random locations.
 Stability improvements in multiplayer sessions.
 Added recoil for hits, shots, and explosions.
 Some weapons now always cause dismemberment.
 Different types of grenades added.
 Bosses introduced.
 Trader NPC with quests.
 Community chest to store items between sessions.
 Game version check implemented.

Bug Fixes:


 Players can no longer shoot while downed.
 Players cannot open inventory while downed.
 Fixed engine sound bug for certain vehicles.
 Fixed issue when joining a game after entering the wrong code.
 Improved area occlusion system.
 Enhanced inventory saving system.
 Fixed object scaling issues for clients.


Enjoy it!

notes.title: v0.3.3.92 - Bugfixing and combat improvements
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

- Zombies clipping through the ground: Fixed
- Tutorial not showing after restarting the game: Fixed
- Improved melee system: Multiple zombies can be hit at once
- Improved shooting system: Reduced precision required
- Enhanced vehicle access: Driver's seat is now the default position
- Increased loot for consumable items
